summary:
AstroKites is an Earth observation and climate intelligence platform that transforms raw satellite data into actionable decision-making for India. Built on NASA Earth Observation datasets and official India Meteorological Department (IMD) advisories, the platform bridges scientific telemetry with grassroots agricultural and societal needs.

We developed an integrated full-stack system featuring interactive geospatial maps with live severe weather alerts, a multi-year decadal climate comparison engine, and a Smart Agriculture advisor. The agriculture engine pairs localized seasonal forecasts with ICAR soil parameters and real-time AGMARKNET mandi market prices to recommend climate-resilient crops, sowing windows, and price trends.

This project directly addresses the challenge by demystifying complex Earth science for communities facing intensifying climate volatility. Rather than relying on static or synthetic estimates, AstroKites delivers transparent, data-grounded insights that empower farmers, resource planners, and travelers to proactively anticipate weather risks, optimize resources, safeguard livelihoods, and build long-term environmental resilience.
details:
AstroKites – Earth Observation & Climate Intelligence Platform

AstroKites is an integrated climate intelligence platform that combines satellite data, weather information, agricultural insights, and market prices to support smarter decision-making across India.

1. What It Does & How It Works

AstroKites has four major features:

1. Interactive Geospatial Intelligence & Weather Alerts

  • Displays real-time weather alerts from the India Meteorological Department (IMD).
  • Supports Red, Orange, and Yellow alert categories.
  • Uses interactive Leaflet maps to highlight affected locations.
  • Provides weather details, hazard boundaries, and safety recommendations.

2. Smart Agriculture & Mandi Market Analysis

  • Recommends suitable crops based on weather, soil, water, market conditions, and seasonal factors.
    • Weather – 30%
    • Soil – 25%
    • Water – 15%
    • Market – 20%
    • Seasonal Window – 10%
  • Integrates ICAR agricultural guidelines and AGMARKNET market data.
  • Displays 7-day, 30-day, and 90-day market price trends, modal prices, and arrival volumes.

3. Climate Comparison Center

  • Compares historical climate conditions from 1990 to 2026.
  • Analyzes temperature, rainfall, and other climate variations.
  • Displays monthly changes, percentage differences, and unusual climate patterns.

4. Climate-Smart Travel Planner

  • Helps users identify the best time to visit Indian destinations.
  • Analyzes temperature, rainfall probability, and weather comfort.
  • Suggests suitable travel periods based on climate conditions.

2. Key Benefits

  • Better Decisions for Farmers: Helps farmers select suitable crops based on weather, soil conditions, and market prices.
  • Reliable Data: Uses authentic satellite, government, and meteorological data instead of generating artificial weather alerts or market prices.
  • Early Risk Identification: Highlights agricultural risks such as drought, frost, heat stress, and excessive rainfall.
  • Better Resource Management: Supports efficient irrigation, water conservation, and crop planning.
  • Easy Climate Understanding: Converts complex scientific data into interactive maps, charts, and understandable insights.

3. Intended Impact

  • Agricultural Development: Helps farmers improve productivity and make informed farming decisions.
  • Economic Benefits: Connects crop suitability with market demand and mandi prices to support better financial decisions.
  • Climate Awareness: Makes satellite and climate information accessible to students, researchers, farmers, and citizens.
  • Environmental Sustainability: Encourages responsible water usage and climate-friendly agricultural practices.
  • Disaster Preparedness: Helps communities understand weather risks and take preventive action.

External APIs and Data Sources:

  • NASA POWER API – Temperature, humidity, solar radiation, and wind data.
  • NASA GPM IMERG – Satellite-based precipitation observations.
  • IMD – Official weather warnings and bulletins.
  • AGMARKNET / data.gov.in – Agricultural market prices and arrivals.
  • ICAR – Agricultural research and crop suitability guidelines.

5. Creativity & Innovation

AstroKites introduces several innovative features:

  • Satellite + Agriculture Integration: Combines Earth observation data with agricultural market information.
  • Intelligent Crop Recommendations: Uses a weighted scoring algorithm to rank suitable crops.
  • Transparent Scoring: Explains why a particular crop is recommended instead of providing unexplained AI-generated results.
  • Interactive Weather Visualization: Allows users to explore affected regions through dynamic maps and weather alerts.
  • Climate-Based Travel Planning: Uses climate information to identify comfortable travel periods.

6. Important Factors Considered

  • Geographical Diversity: Supports different Indian climatic regions, including Himalayan areas, deserts, and tropical regions.
  • Data Accuracy: Prioritizes authentic government and satellite datasets.
  • Performance: Uses asynchronous APIs and SQLite caching to reduce loading time and unnecessary API requests.
  • Network Reliability: Provides cached information and clear data-source status when external APIs are unavailable.
  • Mobile Responsiveness: Provides an accessible interface across desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
  • Testing & Reliability: Uses Pytest to test 51 platform endpoints and mathematical engines.

7. Project Summary

AstroKites is an intelligent Earth observation and climate intelligence platform that transforms satellite data, weather information, and agricultural market insights into actionable decisions. It empowers farmers with smarter crop recommendations, helps communities prepare for extreme weather, enables climate comparisons, and supports sustainable tourism across India.
